description: This file is a Rust source code file implementing a Foreign Function Interface (FFI) wrapper for the `kmr_cf::ta_main` function, used in the context of KeyMint Trusted Application (TA) core for Cuttlefish. It defines an external C function `kmr_ta_main` that manages security levels and handles file descriptors for secure environment operations.

methods.name: kmr_ta_main
methods.description: An unsafe extern 'C' function that wraps the `kmr_cf::ta_main` call, managing security levels and file descriptors for secure environment operations.
